text:
alessa: tiny design sync 1 - updated rules editor mock: added a compact sticky help panel, tightened chip padding, and a preview overlay state when there are validation errors. filing this thread for UX + a11y quick checks: contrast, keyboard flow with sticky header, and phrasing for the disabled preview state. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz (mock) mike: looks cleaner. quick feedback: 1) sticky help takes ~72px which feels heavy on smaller screens, can it collapse to a 36px bar on scroll? 2) chips look lighter than before, might fail WCAG for 14px. sara: ran quick contrast check: chip bg #EEF2F7 + text #111827 = 3.8:1 at 14px. fails. options: darken text to #0B1320 (4.6:1) or change bg to #E6EBF2. prefer darkening text to keep token palette. alessa: keep density, so darken text is better. mike: ok with #0B1320? sara: yes meets 4.5:1. nate: behavior question for preview: when rules are invalid, do we still let users toggle simulation on and show errors in the preview, or block the toggle? product preference is to block and show inline banner saying: "Resolve rule issues to enable preview." less noisy than modal. jo: implementation notes: will add aria-live="polite" region for validation status updates and aria-hidden on preview when overlay active. snippet i'll use: ```
2 rules invalid: missing target
Resolve rule issues to enable preview
``` also will add focus trap to keep keyboard users within the rules list when overlay is shown. mike: keyboard/nav edge: when focus lands on a rule near the top, the sticky help currently obscures the focus ring. we should auto-scroll focused item beneath the help bar or make the help collapse on keyboard focus. sara: a11y copy tweak: change "Fix rules to preview" -> "Resolve rule issues to enable preview". longer but clearer and works better with screen readers. avoid "fix" as verb on disabled controls. alessa: decision: chip text -> #0B1320 at 14px; add .rule-item:focus outline 2px solid #2563EB; help panel collapses to compact bar (36px) on scroll/keyboard focus; preview toggle disabled when invalid with inline banner copy per sara; aria-live for updates and aria-hidden on preview region. jo 1 can you open a PR with these changes and include visual regression snapshots for normal/overlay states plus the updated design token? jo: will open branch jo/ux/rules-preview-overlay. PR will include CSS changes, aria updates, e2e test that verifies: 1) preview disabled when invalid, 2) aria-live text appears, 3) focused rule visible under header. will add i18n key: preview.disabled.resolve_rules = "Resolve rule issues to enable preview". deploy-bot: queued visual-regression: jo/ux/rules-preview-overlay. i'll post results. nate: also request: add a short note in component docs about help panel collapsing behaviour and the preview-disabled state so PMs/designers know the rationale. alessa: good call. i'll add docs blurb after PR merges. thanks team :thumbsup:
